summary: Executed M2 backend+frontend regression on public preview URL for scoped Watch reader, legacy Watch authority boundary, CORS hardening, and Grey Mirror watch record UX. Backend transport diagnostics regression is fixed (all 5 isolated tests green); scoped Watch authority matrix is mostly green; one critical CORS mismatch and multiple frontend M2 acceptance gaps remain.

critical.issue: Configured preview origin preflight is denied with HTTP 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' (same as unlisted origin). This breaks allowed-origin browser auth flow despite explicit CORS_ORIGINS setting.

ui_bugs.issue: Required status filters 'Refused' and 'Held' were not present in /os/admin/greymirror/watch/record (only All/Observation/Action/Decision surfaced).

ui_bugs.component: Watch evidence drawer Open census action
ui_bugs.issue: Clicking drawer 'Open census' did not navigate to the expected census record route; URL stayed on /os/admin/greymirror/watch/record.

Required literal CTA 'Open the source →' and stable controls [data-testid^='registry-source-link-'] were not present on tested /os/admin/estate views, so single-request source-open behavior could not be validated.

integration_issues.flow: Open census from watch row drawer
integration_issues.issue: Watch row walk opens drawer correctly, but Open census action does not transfer to census history/detail view.

issues: Record column readability improved; no horizontal overflow detected in sampled watch rows.
No text overlap observed in sampled long basis/evidence lines within visible rows.

action_items: Fix CORS allowed-origin matching so preview origin preflight succeeds while unlisted origins remain denied without ACAO.
Restore/implement required watch status filters Refused and Held in /os/admin/greymirror/watch/record.
Fix watch drawer Open census navigation to open the intended census record route.
Restore required source CTA literal 'Open the source →' and [data-testid^='registry-source-link-'] on the intended registry view so request-count behavior can be validated.
critical_code_review_comments: M2 scoped reader backend contract is largely correct: anonymous 401, analyst 403, operator 200, run-id parity with census cursor, and legacy write routes auth-bound 409 with non-mutating refusal body all validated.
Tenant isolation behavior for conflicting explicit tenant + linked census_run_id is correctly enforced in isolated mocked-store test (conflicting DIGICOW-tenant record is filtered out).
Iteration58 deep_dispatch transport_diagnostic retention is now working on success path (all 5 isolated mocked tests passed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use public URL from frontend/.env. Backend pytest run: 19 passed, 1 failed (CORS allowed origin denied). Scoped Watch APIs and legacy write refusals are mostly green. For frontend, navigation tabs state/record/under-watch/decisions pass and responsive readability is improved, but source-link CTA/testids are missing on tested estate views and drawer Open census did not navigate.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 CORS: OPTIONS /api/auth/login returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' for both configured preview origin and unlisted origin, indicating running-origin comparison mismatch (likely env/runtime origin list mismatch or edge-origin normalization drift). RCA-2 Watch drawer action: Open census button renders in drawer but click does not change route; action binding or navigation target handoff is not executing in rendered context. RCA-3 Source CTA gap: required text/testid contract for source child link is absent on tested registry/estate routes, preventing single-click request counting verification.
